Carnosinase deficiency disrupts peptide metabolism; seizures, intellectual disability and regression annotated in 80-99%. Carnosinuria alone is not renal damage.
Astrocytic neurodegeneration and leukodystrophy; dysphagia and eye movement abnormalities reflect neural dysfunction. Scoliosis is a secondary deformity.
